title: Syrian Lamb Kebabs
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish made with lamb, herbs, and spices, inspired by Syrian cuisine. Perfect for a quick dinner or outdoor BBQ.

ingredients.name: Herb blend
ingredients.notes: mix of oregano, thyme, and rosemary

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, herb blend, Syrian kebab spice mix, salt, and black pepper.
Add lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat.
Thread lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until lamb reaches 145°F (63°C).
Brush with lime juice during the last minute of grilling.
Let kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve hot with your favorite sides, such as rice, salad, or pita bread.
